name: FND_TABLE_DATASHAPES
description: This table will be used to maintain the Table level Datashape Info for all Fusion Tables. It will store the current Datashape Info (Actual) which will be automatically populated by a script and also the Target Datashape Info to be populated by the Table Owners based on their requirements. The goal is to match both Target and Actual values.

columns.name: TABLE_ROWCOUNT_TARGET
columns.description: Target # of Rows the Table should contain

columns.name: TABLE_ROWCOUNT_ACTUAL
columns.description: Current # of Rows in the Table, Read-Only value

columns.name: PRODUCT_FAMILY_NAME
columns.description: Product Family Name this table belongs to

columns.name: MISMATCH_FLAG
columns.description: This value is automatically updated based on the values of Target and Actual values. If Target Value != Actual Value then Mismatch_Flag = 'Y'. Valid values are 'Y' and 'N', Read-Only value

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).
